name: python-ofiq
description: OFIQ scalar and vector quality scoring adapter with graceful fallback.

features.name: scalar_quality
features.description: Returns a single 0-100 quality score for each image.

features.name: vector_quality
features.description: Returns a per-image quality dimension vector summary.

features.name: setup_data
features.description: Runs a live capability probe (in-memory image decode + output-dir writability), advertises the active quality dimensions, and persists the report; status is 'ready' or 'degraded' based on the probe.
